title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the article for its parts (title, paragraphs, picture) and gives its main message in one sentence.
representations: a short article with a picture
steps: Read the title and look at the picture.
Underline the main sentence of each.

board.do: Point at the title and the first paragraph.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the message of the article in one sentence.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kwa mujibu wa makala, maji yachemshwe kwa muda gani?" Kwa nini "dakika tano" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu la swali la makala liko ndani ya makala. Tafuta sentensi inayolisema.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ujumbe mkuu wa makala ni upi?" Kwa nini "Maji huchemshwa kwa moto." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe mkuu unatokana na makala nzima, si sentensi moja.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Makala inasema maji yawekwe wapi baada ya kuchemshwa?" Kwa nini "jikoni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Soma swali tena na utafute sehemu ya makala inayolijibu.

misconceptions.ask: Mwandishi anataka ufanye nini baada ya kusoma?
misconceptions.repair: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni kile mwandishi anataka ujue au ufanye.
